name: Handle Changed or New QBO SalesReceipt ( {QBO SalesReceipt} )
purpose: Entry point for a QuickBooks Online sales receipt change: formats the QBO SalesReceipt JSON, converts it to a Karbon sales receipt JSON and passes it to the sales receipt create-or-update script (428), returning its result.
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/427 "Convert QBO SalesReceipt Into Karbon SalesReceipt" (step 25; Perform Script)
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/428 "Create or Update SalesReceipt ( { SalesReceipt } )" (step 30; Perform Script)
open_question: Called from LedgerLink (Handle_SalesReceipt_Update step 18) through $$DataSourceControllerFile, which points at karbon_kontroller; confirm. Error from the conversion step is not checked before the create-or-update call. Script 428 is the public wrapper of the private receipt script 584.
